overview: Livestock Health Pattern Triage addresses telemetry is noisy or missing, so operators spend time interpreting unrelated warnings in agriculture and food production operations. The first proof of value uses animal wearables, feeding patterns and vet histories. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is time to vet review for confirmed illness, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.
kpi: time to vet review for confirmed illness

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: animal wearables, feeding patterns and vet histories; define time to vet review for confirmed illness and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Farm Operations Director / Food Quality Head.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including inject sensor failures, stale data and dependency loss into the pilot.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
